name: Gemini
summary: Gemini is Google's assistant, available on the web and in Google accounts. A business user can ask questions, draft text, and work with files they already keep in Google.
paragraphs: Gemini is Google's assistant, available on the web and in Google accounts. A business user can ask questions, draft text, and work with files they already keep in Google.
whyItMatters: Use it for everyday questions and drafts alongside the Google tools the team already has.
